 Public Declaration of Agreed Compliance Measures (Section 29) 
 No Longer Applicable
 Arianne Reza 
 · Deputy Minister 
 Description 
Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures that are agreed upon by a public office holder and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act), to assist the public office holder in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of public office holders and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends.
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me in order to avoid the appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interests of my relative, Kayvan Lira, or to give preferential treatment to his employer Databricks or its subsidiaries, affiliates and associates, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a reporting public office holder.
Accordingly, I have agreed to pre-emptively recuse myself from any discussion or decision in relation to Kayvan Lira and his employer Databricks. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter or decision-making processes affecting my relative’s interests.
This screen is administered by my Chief of Staff and Deputy Minister of Employment and Social Development Canada, Paul Thompson, to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decision-making process
